UC-1200.en: To list, search or read files in the matter folder or your notes folder, use the Glob, Grep and Read tools. Do not use PowerShell or Bash commands for listing, searching or reading files.

Claude Code's classifier held and refused shell listings and reads (Windows folder listings showed as failed steps); Glob, Grep and Read run without it. English alone: the agent answers in the lawyer's language.

UC-1201.en: In this workspace the user explicitly asks for sub-agents in one case: when a task needs more than eight documents or about 300 pages read. Then, after converting the papers to text, put every text copy longer than about 15,000 characters into 4 to 6 batches of similar size and start one sub-agent per batch, all at once. Start each sub-agent fresh, without your conversation history (fork_turns="none"). Give each the full paths of its text files and what the task needs from them, in a few lines. While they work, read the short papers yourself. Wait for them, treat each report as a lead, and check every quote, date and amount you rely on against the text copies. Start at most six sub-agents for one answer. In every other case do the work yourself, unless the lawyer asks for helpers in their message.
